messages:
alex: quick sync — prepping 44b variant for onboarding. putting weights at s3://redwood-models/onboard/cleft-44b/v1/ — heads up on tokenizer oddness (see below).

maria: noted. can you post the exact manifest? also which quantization profile are you planning?

alex: manifest is the `manifest.json` at that prefix. qprofile `q4_0_fast` for smoke. if that looks bad we'll switch to `q4_1_balanced`.

sami: re tokenizer oddness — when you run with sliding-window 2048->4096 we saw token id drift for long rope contexts (rotary scale mismatch). small repro attached earlier.

alex: yeah saw that in local. seems related to positional scaling in our RoPE impl when chunking. config I'm testing: `serve.conf` snippet:
```
model: cleft-44b
attn: rotary_scale: true
rope_scale: auto
sliding_window: {size: 2048, stride: 1024}
```
jen: can you try toggling `rope_scale: off` and see if the tokenizer fallback fixes? might be cheaper than patching right now.

alex: tried `off` — generation looks stable but quality drops on long-form. short-term we can fallback to smaller window.

kevin: for the GQA/MQA flags — make sure `multi_query: true` only for 8/16-bit kernels. if using q4 quant we should keep `multi_query: false` to avoid perf cliffs.

maria: oof thanks. so for this run: qprofile `q4_0_fast`, `multi_query: false`, `rope_scale: auto` but patch kv-prefetching to avoid fragmenting cache?

alex: exactly. also adding a tokenizer override until we fix the encoder: `tokenizer_override: {pad_to_multiple_of: 8, use_fast: false}` — that helped local decode mismatch.

cbot: deploy-check: model manifest exists at s3://redwood-models/onboard/cleft-44b/v1/manifest.json (size 12.1MB) — weights files: 44 shards present — checksum OK.

jen: great. can someone post the minimal repro command for the RoPE drift? I'll triage first pass.

sami: repro (run on node with mixed precision):
```bash
python -m smoke.repro --model s3://redwood-models/onboard/cleft-44b/v1 --max-len 4096 --prompt-file tests/rope_drift_prompts.txt
```
observed: token ids diverge at 2300+ tokens, outputs start repeating old context.

kevin: for debugging add `--dump-kv` and compare kv shapes. if shapes mismatch that's a sign of window-fragment scaling bug.

alex: adding those flags and will push logs to /tmp/cleft-44b-rope-debug.tar.gz and link here shortly.

maria: also FYI: console config lint flagged `tokenizer_override.use_fast: false` — we need an exception if we keep that. filing a quick ticket.

jen: ok plan: alex runs repro with `--dump-kv`, uploads logs; if kv shapes match we try `rope_scale: off` fallback for the canary; otherwise block rollback and engage runtime patch. Sami/kevin to own kv/attn debug. I'll coordinate rollout windows.

alex: logs uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.corp/tmp/cleft-44b-rope-debug.tar.gz (permission open to eng-runtime).

sami: grabbing now. thanks. will ping after kv diff. :thumbsup:

kevin: quick note — if we fallback to smaller sliding window we should also change batching profile (reduce max_batch_size) to keep latency SLO.

maria: adding checklist to thread: 1) confirm kv shapes 2) try rope_scale off perf/quality 3) canary with reduced window 4) update console lint exception 5) formal issue for tokenizer encoder fix.

alex: thanks — will update status in this thread as steps complete.
